chunks: Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام was asked about the nafilah prayer during the daytime while traveling.
So he said: "If the nafilah were valid in travel, the obligatory prayer would have been completed."
ai.seo_question: Can daytime nafilah prayers be performed while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning prayer during travel. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام indicates that daytime nafilah prayer is not prescribed in travel, and supports this by linking it to the shortening of the obligatory prayer.
